notes.title: Shelter Manager is Coming!
notes.content:
New game is coming!

Background
By the time the alarm starts ringing in the bunker, you still haven't found out what happened. You can only guess. One thing is certain - the world will never be the same again. There is a whole new reality waiting for you, where the struggle for resources with other survivors will become the main problem.
Get to the truth. Find out what happened to the people on the surface.

About the game
Take control over the bunker and expand it. Manage power, production, and even sleep schedule. Rebuild your bunkers and expand them. Send expeditions to the surface to rescue any survivors or the other way around for looting and pillaging. Capture outlying bunkers until your network covers the entire country. Your mission is to repopulate the human race - and only you know how to do it.
An unpredictable campaign is waiting for you, in which you will have to get to the truth and find out what happened on the surface.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1256830/Shelter_Manager/

notes.title: One more update (5 points)!
notes.content:
Some changes that we have prepared for you
Corrected: Starting religions in 1750 are now placed correctly.
Changed: Now the number of rebels is growing faster than before. Each turn, the number of rebels grows by 3.5% instead of 2.5% due to a decrease in the number of civilians.
Changed: Countries will begin to search for a suitable enemy to attack a little slower.
Changed: Now the general battle will occur 24% earlier than before the update. Wars will go faster.
Changed: In battles against a very weak opponent you will capture more territories than before.
Also today will be updated version for MacOS (will add Throne Hall)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997460/9b7e9869dda6a53cdb839e9b0d58282369309205.jpg

notes.title: A Huge update is already in Game!
notes.content:
A big update is already completed and available!
- Added: Throne Room. Now capturing different regions, you can gradually improve your Throne Room. In the end, if you become the emperor of half the world - you must see somewhere a manifestation of this, right?
- Fixed: We fixed a bug in which you were not allowed to play anymore after the second victory. Now you can capture the whole world and get 5 levels of victories.
- Changed: The population of all leading countries in the 1750 world map is changed to realistic according to historical documents. Also changed a number of other indicators of this map.
- Changed: Jerusalem is corrected in the map of 1207 (too small population after hiring scientists). This region is still the "Easter egg" we left for you. It starts from an incredibly high level of science, but from the start there is very little population. Can you find all the other "Easter eggs" that we hid for you?)
Thank you for your support!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997460/797574b603dab05d1eaae14f3057c6eaa22e2f82.jpg

notes.title: Monday update
notes.content:
Today we fixed a couple of mistakes and changed the balance.
- Fixed: Save and load in singleplayer now work correctly
- Fixed: Added Turkish language to game setings
- Changed: Science for the automatic production of troops soldiers builds fewer units
- Changed: Science on the automatic construction of specialized units of your nation is now building 2 times more units
- Changed: Increased the aggressiveness of the AI, for more frequent search for a weak country to attack
- Changed: Reduced AI peace-loving (less likely to improve relationships, less often "close their eyes" to wars on their borders)

On Wensday we will add the Throne Room to the game.
We will also add another victory level when capturing 100% of the regions.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997460/3afd7264facf3ca5e2d9009bdf0a5af2887a5995.jpg

notes.title: Last two weeks updates
notes.content:
So what have we updated in the last two weeks
1. Added to the window of the country the ability to negotiate
2. Added to the window of the country the opportunity to send army vs current country.
3. Added on the global map the relation of the country to you in the form of stars (on the die of each country).
4. Added purpose for auto-negotiation in the menu of country. Now you can set the goal to which every turn should change relation.
5. Added restriction of relations with the country depending on the relationship of your religions.
6. Added coefficients to the emergence of rebels in the capture of regions of different religion. Conventionally, if catholics capture the muslim region, the rebels will be about 60% of the population of captured region.
7. Added the ability to conduct cavalry raids and attacks of assassins simultaneously with the war.
8. Added the ability to carry out raids by cavalry and attacks by assassins on countries with which you are not at war. However, it will spoil your relationship.
9. Added an additional restriction at the beginning of the war - when the armies didnt conduct a main battle in the first turn.
10. Increased the maximum limit of captured regions depending on the turn of the game.
11. Added a change in the cost of changing diplomatic relations depending on the turn of the game. The later - the more expensive it will be to use diplomacy.
12. Significantly reworked AI and the logic of war.
Also a lot of windows have been redesigned and fixed a lot of bugs. Also reworked the map of 1750 year and made it more realistic. Even the population in the country corresponds to some historical works.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997460/2d424c824c25dd62243dbb164d820bbde373a877.jpg

notes.title: Design update
notes.content:
We are now in the middle of a design update. We will insert a new style of windows into the game and into the store already on Tuesday - so it’s not long to wait. Some of the screenshots that have already been posted are also redrawn and will soon be replaced in the store.
In addition, today we have completed a new map. And it turns out really super! The real landscape looks very fresh and revives the whole design. On Tuesday we will add it to the game and we will be able to post new screenshots on the Steam page.
